messages.subject: Major release update to v1.0.0
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am pleased to announce the first major release of brainGraph, making it v1.0.0. This update is both on CRAN (so you can install it with the command "install.packages") and on my Github page.

There have been an extensive number of changes too long to list here; you can see the log in the NEWS.md file <https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph/commit/76fa153b3ac43c637ff1f2802e4a34e7e47d1346?short_path=8312ad0#diff-8312ad0561ef661716b48d09478362f3> (also here: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/brainGraph/news.html). Several function names have been changed, several have been added, and I added the "Craddock-200" atlas. I also made many speed improvements for several functions.

I will be updating the User Guide fully in the next day or two; I have been updating it over time but it is not quite finished. You will find that the chapters have changed somewhat; I hope the organization makes more sense. I have also added quite a bit to Chapter 10 "Benchmarks", reflecting the speed improvements I made for the current version.

Please report any bugs, feature requests, issues, etc. to the mailing list.
Chris

messages.subject: Update to v1.1.0
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I have made an update to package version 1.1.0. You can find the changes at the NEWS.md file <https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph/commit/681fec00e7c6e704373ac7a0e8d6a872546260f5?short_path=8312ad0#diff-8312ad0561ef661716b48d09478362f3>.

There are multiple changes, including a fix to the GUI, and I have changed the lobe, neighborhood, and community selection frames to be "scrolled windows".

I have implemented the "multi-threshold permutation correction (MTPC)" method (see Drakesmith et al., 2015). I have also added a "level" argument to "brainGraph_GLM", which allow you to perform between-group inference for graph-level metrics (e.g., global efficiency).

The connectivity matrices (DTI and fMRI) are now symmetrized; the default is "max" (which is also igraph's default), but you can choose "min" or "avg" in the function "create_mats" using the argument "symm.by <http://symm.by>".

Finally, I have added functions to calculate "communicability" and "communicability betweenness".

Please let me know if you have any questions, experience bugs, etc. I have updated the User Guide to reflect these changes.

Chris

messages.subject: Update to v1.2.0
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I have updated the package to v1.2.0. You may find the changes in the NEWS.md file <https://github.com/cwatson/brainGraph/commit/1213e483e29e655b1056abcf228ba1e755373ad7?short_path=8312ad0#diff-8312ad0561ef661716b48d09478362f3>.

A particularly major change to "create_mats" is the addition of a value given to "sub.thresh". You may now specify "mean" as the value, and it will keep connections that satisfy
mean(A_ij) + 2*SD(A_ij) > threshold

See the references in the User Guide (Chapter 6) for some examples in the literature.

I have also added a function to calculate the "s-core" membership, and have made available the "make_empty_brainGraph" function, which creates an empty graph for a specific atlas, with the correct name and lobe attributes.

Please let me know if you have questions, errors, etc.

Chris
